variants.headline: Building project badly behind schedule
variants.body:
The project {project} is badly behind schedule. The delay is the established failure against its timetable, not a complete account of why it occurred. Readers considering {target} should distinguish that known position from invented shortages, contractor disputes or financial consequences not supplied in the report.

Behind schedule. Badly. A building project has failed the calendar's test, and there is no need to invent a row to make that interesting. Readers can demand responsibility without being promised a new finishing date that exists only because it makes the story feel more complete.

We defend {target} against a verdict based on the delay alone. Lateness is established, but its existence does not prove every adverse claim about responsibility or the merits of the project. Readers deserve a clear story and a straight answer about responsibility.
